title: End cards: lost items as tiles, a loss figure, contract chips
why: The critic scored the Killed in action card 2 of 5: no hero figure, five rows each repeating Lost with the name in rarity colour, long green contract sentences. Now one tile row (64px, 3px rarity bar, x2 stacks), one 56px loss figure, one chip per contract. The old words stay as hidden text. Restyle only.
now: The death card shows lost items as tiles with one big loss figure.
